note: What the probe reads once, on a GitHub runner, so the collectors are written against real pages. Every host is read through collegiate/polite.js (robots.txt first, one request at a time per host, 2 s apart, longer where robots.txt asks). Hosts and URLs are candidates to verify, not facts: one that does not answer is recorded as such. Round 8, from the first backfill (2026-10-21): WMT schedules read at 12 of 28 sites (Vanderbilt one game a season, LSU's paths use its own sport code 'bsb', Nebraska, Clemson and Penn State end in a 404); SIDEARM's older sites read recent seasons but not older ones ('the page is the null schedule'), and George Mason and Bradley give 'no schedule data'; UMKC (SIDEARM) gives none either.
